Definition: to have (transitively, exercise; reflexively, get) dominion
BiblicalUsage: Sarar is ruling, from the house to the kingdom. Ahasuerus decreed that every man should bear rule in his own house; Hosea charges Israel with setting up kings, but not by God; and Isaiah promises the other side of it — a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.
TheologicalSignificance: What strikes me is how often ruling goes wrong when men take it for themselves. Korah's charge against Moses was the same claim — thou makest thyself altogether a prince over us — and God did not accept it. I believe true rule is given by God, not seized, and it is measured by righteousness and judgment.
